Hello! I am Ayşe. What is your name?
Hi, Ayşe. My name is Tom. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too, Tom. How are you?
I am fine, thank you. And you?
I am fine too. Are you a new student?
Yes, I am a student. Are you a student too?
Yes! I am your classmate. Welcome!
Oh, great! Goodbye, see you tomorrow, Ayşe.
I am hungry. Is this cafe open for breakfast?
Good morning! Yes, breakfast is from seven to ten.
Can we see the menu, please?
Here you are. We have eggs, cheese, bread and tea.
I eat an egg and bread. And you, Merve?
I drink tea, and I like cheese. No coffee for me, please.
Sugar for Merve, please. For me, no sugar, but some salt on the egg!
A small mistake: I brought coffee. Sorry! Tea is coming.
No problem. This bread is delicious!
Can we have the bill, please?
Excuse me, can you help me?
Where is the train station? My train is at three.
The station is near. It is not far from here.
Is it on the left or on the right?
Go straight, then turn left at the hotel. The station is on the right.
Thank you! Is there a bus to the airport too?
Yes, the bus stop is near the station. Look at the map here.
Oh, I see it! My bag is heavy, so the bus is a good idea.
You are welcome. Have a good trip!
Look at this photo. This is my family.
Wow, your family is big! How many brothers do you have?
I have two brothers and one sister. This woman is my mother.
No, that is my uncle. My father is next to my grandmother.
Oh, I see. Your grandfather looks young!
Yes, he is sixty, but he is very strong. He loves football.
My family is small. I have no brothers or sisters.
Yes, she lives with us. I love my grandmother very much.
Look at that blue dress! I like it very much.
It is beautiful. But how much is it?
Excuse me, how much is this dress?
The price is on the tag. Oh no, it is very expensive!
Too expensive... And that red shirt?
The red shirt is small and cheap. How much are these shoes?
The shoes are too big for me. I want the shirt, please.
OK, we'll take the shirt. The dress stays in the shop!
Thank you! Next month I will save my money for the blue dress.
So, this is your new office? It is big!
Yes, I work here now. I am an engineer.
Great! Is your team busy today?
Very busy. We have a meeting at two, and I write reports on my computer.
I am still a student. I learn English at school.
Good for you! Do you read English books?
Yes, I read a book every night. But I write with a blue pen in class.
Ha ha! Our teacher at school was very strict.
I want to be an engineer too, like you.
Then study hard! Working in an office is fun.
Good morning, Leyla! It is sunny today.
Yes, the weather is nice now. What time is it?
It is ten o’clock. Let’s go to the park.
Great idea! Tomorrow is Monday, so today we rest.
Look at the sky... Oh no, it is rainy now!
Really? It was sunny an hour ago!
The weather changes fast in autumn. It is cold too.
So, no park. Hot tea and a movie at home?
Perfect. What time does the movie start?
At three o’clock. We have five hours!
It is Friday! What do you do at the weekend, Kaan?
I play football with my friends on Saturday morning.
Nice! I like music. I play the guitar in the afternoon.
Really? Can you play a song for me?
Sure! I like to play slow songs. And on Sunday I run in the park.
I do not like running. But I like to swim in the sea in summer.
Me too! Hey, maybe we can cook dinner together on Sunday evening?
Good idea! I take photos of the food for my album.
Deal! First your football, then my guitar, then dinner.
Good morning, Aslı! Did you have a good weekend?
Yes! I visited my grandmother yesterday. We drank tea and talked.
Nice. I stayed home on Saturday and watched a movie.
An old adventure film. Then my mother cooked fish for dinner. It was delicious!
I ate rice and chicken at my grandmother’s house.
Did you go out on Sunday too?
Yes! I went to the park and played football with my cousins. We had a lot of fun.
Wow, you had a busy weekend. I only met my friends on Friday for coffee.
Ha ha! Next weekend, let’s do something together.
Hi Lara! I have some good news. My birthday is next week.
Oh, happy birthday in advance! Are you going to have a party?
Yes! Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
I would love to! What time does it start?
It starts at seven o’clock. My cousin is going to play the guitar.
Great! Maybe I will bring a cake.
Sure, but no presents, please. Your presence is enough!
Deal. Are you going to invite our teacher too?
Ha ha, maybe. It will rain on Saturday, but we will stay inside, so no problem.
Perfect, I can’t wait! See you on Saturday.
Good morning. I do not feel well today.
I am sorry to hear that. What is wrong?
My head hurts and I have a bad cough. I think I have a fever too.
Let me see... Yes, a small fever. Did you sleep last night?
No, I was sick all night. My back hurts too.
It sounds like the flu. You should rest for two days and drink a lot of water.
OK. Do I need some medicine?
Yes, take this medicine twice a day, after breakfast and dinner.
Thank you. I feel better already.
Get well soon! See the doctor if it gets worse.
Good morning, Ceren. Thank you for coming. Please, sit down.
Good morning. Thank you for the invitation.
So, tell me about yourself. Do you have any experience?
Yes. I have worked at a small office for three years, and I have been a team leader since last year.
Impressive. Could you send me an e-mail with your references?
Of course. I will send it this afternoon. Could you tell me more about the team?
Our team is small but very good. We work hard and help each other.
That sounds great. May I ask about the salary?
Certainly. It is above average, plus health insurance.
Wonderful. I would like to work here very much.
We will call you tomorrow. Have a nice day, Ceren.
Hallo, Ayşe. Ich bin Tom. Bist du die neue Lehrerin?
Auch gut. Ich habe zwei Brüder.
Nein, zwei! Meine Familie ist groß.
Das ist schön. Und wer ist unser Lehrer?
Das ist Herr Klein. Er ist gut.
Ich habe Hunger. Und du, Can?
Ich esse keinen Fisch, aber der Salat ist frisch.
Ich trinke Tee. Ist Zucker im Tee?
Ja, der Zucker ist auf dem Tisch.
Der Käse ist lecker. Isst du Käse?
Ja, ich esse Käse. Und du, isst du ein Ei?
Ben, komm! Das ist meine Familie.
Ja. Meine Mutter, mein Vater, zwei Brüder und eine Schwester.
Nein, aber mein Bruder hat ein Kind.
Und wer ist der große Mann dort?
Das ist mein Bruder. Er ist groß.
Oh, ich dachte, das ist dein Ehemann!
Nein, ich habe keinen Ehemann. Ich habe nur eine große Familie.
Das ist schön. Ich liebe meine Familie auch.
Er ist nah: geradeaus und dann links.
Das Hotel ist rechts, neben dem Bahnhof.
Oh nein, meine Tasche ist nicht hier!
Warten Sie! Ist die Tasche in Ihrem Auto?
Ja! Meine Tasche ist im Auto!
Sehr gut! Und der Zug ist spät.
Dann habe ich Zeit. Vielen Dank!
Guten Tag! Wie viel kostet das blaue Kleid?
Ja, aber das rote Hemd ist billig.
Ich mag das rote Hemd. Ich kaufe es.
Die blauen Schuhe sind auch billig.
Oh nein, ich habe kein Geld mehr!
Kein Problem! Das Hemd ist für Sie.
Guten Morgen, Lena. Wie geht's dir?
Gut, danke. Herr Yılmaz, sind Sie Arzt oder Lehrer?
Ich bin Lehrer. Mein Bruder ist Arzt.
Ja, ich lerne Deutsch in der Schule.
Ich lese ein Buch und schreibe mit einem Stift.
Sehr gut. Ich arbeite heute in meinem Büro. Ich bin beschäftigt.
Ja, heute. Danke, Lena. Bis morgen!
Hallo, Julia! Wie ist das Wetter heute?
Wir bleiben eine Stunde im Park.
Und wie ist das Wetter morgen?
Morgen ist es regnerisch und kalt.
Oh nein! Dann bleibe ich zu Hause.
Ja, heute ist Sonntag. Morgen ist Montag.
Hallo, Lena! Was machst du am Wochenende?
Am Samstag schwimme ich im Meer, am Sonntag tanze ich.
Tanzen! Interessant. Ich laufe am Wochenende im Park.
Und sonst? Hast du andere Hobbys?
Das ist ein schönes Hobby. Magst du Musik?
Ja, ich mag Musik sehr. Und mein Freund Max reist gern.
Nach Berlin. Er macht auch gern Fotos.
Meine Schwester kocht gern. Am Wochenende koche ich manchmal mit ihr.
Lecker! Lass uns am Sonntag zusammen kochen!
Gute Idee! Und danach spielen wir Gitarre.
Sí, soy la nueva estudiante. ¿Y tú?
Yo soy Diego, el amigo de Marta.
Estoy muy bien, gracias. ¡Adiós, hasta mañana!
Yo como pescado y una ensalada.
Un té, por favor. ¿Hay azúcar en el té?
Perdón, para la señora: ¿café o té?
¡No, no! Yo bebo té y él bebe café.
Todo está rico. La cuenta, por favor.
Ana, esta es una foto de mi familia.
Este es mi padre y esta es mi madre.
¿Y el niño pequeño, es tu hijo?
¡No, no! Ese es mi hermano pequeño, Pablo.
¿Tu hijo? ¡Pero tú tienes solo veinte años!
¡Ah, perdón! Y la mujer mayor, ¿es tu abuela?
Sí, mi abuela. Bebe té todos los días.
Tu familia es muy bonita. Quiero a mi familia también.
¿Dónde está el hotel? Mi hotel está cerca de la estación.
El hotel está cerca. Ve a la izquierda.
¿A la izquierda? Gracias. ¿Y el tren está lejos?
No, el tren está cerca también.
A la izquierda primero, luego a la derecha.
Es bonito. Pregunta el precio, por favor.
¡Cincuenta! Es muy caro. No tengo tanto dinero.
Señora, hay una oferta: los zapatos son muy baratos hoy.
Quince euros. Son nuevos y azules.
¡Qué baratos! Mamá, compro los zapatos azules.
Muy bien. Son bonitos y baratos.
Buenos días. ¿Tú eres el ingeniero nuevo?
Sí, soy Emre. Trabajo aquí ahora.
Bienvenido, Emre. Esta es tu oficina.
Hola, Emre. Yo soy Sofía, médica en la escuela cercana.
Mucho gusto, Sofía. Hoy tengo una reunión, ¿verdad?
Sí, la reunión es hoy, a las nueve.
¿Dónde está el ordenador? Necesito escribir un documento.
El ordenador está en tu oficina, a la derecha.
Gracias. Estoy un poco ocupado hoy, perdón.
No pasa nada. Esta tarde leo un libro y aprendo español. ¿Quieres estudiar conmigo?
¡Sí, me gusta la idea! Hasta luego.
Hoy es viernes. ¿Qué hacemos el fin de semana?
Hoy hace sol, pero mañana hay lluvia.
No, el domingo hace calor y hay sol.
Entonces, el domingo es perfecto. ¿A qué hora?
Temprano, por favor. ¿Qué hora es ahora?
Son las cinco. ¿Es muy temprano para ti?
No, está bien. Ahora hace fresco, ¿verdad?
Sí. Nos vemos el domingo a las nueve, en el parque.
¡Perfecto! No me gusta la lluvia, pero me gusta el sol.
¡Hola, İpek! ¿Qué haces el fin de semana?
Es un secreto... Bueno, os cuento: aprendo a tocar la guitarra.
Desde hace dos meses. Me gusta la música y practico todos los días.
A mí me gusta más el fútbol. Juego al fútbol los sábados.
Yo nado y corro en el parque. ¿Y cocinas también, İpek?
Sí, cocino el domingo. Y el sábado toco la guitarra para vosotros.
Canciones españolas. Me gustan las canciones alegres.
Yo hago fotos ese día. ¡Una foto de tu primer concierto!
¡Gracias, amigos! El sábado, en mi casa, después de correr por la mañana.
Perfecto. ¿Viajamos juntos a tu casa? Mi coche está cerca.
¡Vale! Os espero a las cinco. ¡Hasta el sábado!
Bonjour ! Je suis Elif. Je suis étudiante.
Bonjour, Elif ! Je suis Marco. Tu es étudiante aussi ?
Oui, je suis étudiante. Et toi, tu es professeur ?
Non, non ! Je suis étudiant, comme toi !
Ça va bien, merci. Et toi ?
Tu es mon premier ami ici.
Merci, Marco ! Au revoir, à demain !
Non, merci. Je bois du thé.
Oui, il y a du sucre dans le thé, s'il vous plaît.
Je mange du pain et du fromage.
Non, ma famille est petite. J'ai un frère.
Moi, j'ai deux sœurs et un frère !
Deux sœurs ! Ta famille est grande !
Non, elle est petite. Et elle cuisine bien !
J'aime ma famille. Et toi, tu aimes ta famille ?
Où est l'hôtel ? Il est loin ?
Non, il est proche. Tournez à droite !
Attendez, madame... non ! À gauche, à gauche !
Pas de problème. Et la gare ? Elle est loin ?
Oui, la gare est loin. Le bus est proche.
Salut Selin ! Tu aimes cette robe ?
Attends... aujourd'hui c'est pas cher ! Il y a un bon prix !
C'est vrai ? Le prix est bon ?
D'accord ! J'achète la robe bleue. Merci, Pierre !
Oui, je travaille à l'école. Et toi ?
Moi, je travaille dans un bureau.
C'est bien ! Moi, j'ai une réunion aujourd'hui.
Oui, très occupée. J'écris sur mon ordinateur.
Moi, j'apprends le français à l'école.
Ah, j'aime le français ! À demain, Yusuf !
Salut Léa ! Il fait beau aujourd'hui !
Oui, il fait soleil ! Demain c'est dimanche.
Bonne idée ! Quelle heure est-il maintenant ?
Demain il fait chaud ou il fait froid ?
Oui, demain il pleut. Le temps est mauvais...
Pas de problème ! Le pique-nique, c'est lundi !
Camille, tu joues au football le week-end ?
Non, je joue de la guitare le week-end.
Jouer de la guitare, c'est bien !
Et toi ? Tu cours ou tu nages ?
Oui, j'aime la musique. Et toi, tu aimes cuisiner ?
Oui, j'aime voyager ! Mais ce week-end, je joue au football avec mon ami.
Attends... moi aussi j'aime le football ! Je joue avec toi !
Super ! Nous jouons au football le week-end !
Ha ha! Sto bene, grazie. E tu?
Il mio nome è Ayşe. Piacere di conoscerti!
Piacere! Tu sei una studentessa qui?
Sì, io sono una studentessa. Tu sei un insegnante?
No, no: qui sono Marco, il tuo amico!
Ho fame! Andiamo a cena al ristorante?
Grazie. Io mangio pesce e riso.
E formaggio e pane, per favore!
Ah! Allora il conto, per favore!
Scusi, mi può aiutare? Dov'è l'albergo?
L'albergo? È lontano! Vuole un taxi?
L'albergo è vicino! Guarda la mappa!
La mappa... ah! La via è a destra!
Sì! E poi gira a sinistra.
Wow! Questo uomo è mio nonno?
Papà? Ma qui è un ragazzo!
E questa ragazza è mia sorella?
E qui ci sei tu: una bambina!
Sì! Vedi? La mia famiglia è grande.
Anch'io amo la mia famiglia, nonna!
Sì! Mi piace la camicia rossa.
Economica? Allora compro la camicia rossa!
E io guardo i vestiti... Mi piace il vestito blu!
E quelle scarpe blu? Mi piacciono le scarpe blu! Le compro!
Luca! Le scarpe blu sono per me, non per te!
Ah, scusa! Allora... solo la camicia!
Sì, io sono Can. Lavoro qui, in ufficio.
No, dottore no! Io sono ingegnere. Lavoro al computer.
Ah, scusa! Oggi c'è una riunione?
Sì, la riunione è oggi. Sei impegnato?
Sì, molto impegnato! E tu, Pietro?
Anch'io sono impegnato. Ma leggo un libro e imparo l'italiano.
Nove?! Sono in ritardo! Oggi è lunedì! Lavoro!
No, no! Oggi è domenica! Lunedì è domani!
Ah! Domenica! Allora: che tempo fa oggi?
Oggi fa caldo ed è soleggiato!
Buona idea! E sono solo le nove: è presto!
Bene! Il picnic è alle tre in punto!
Alle tre in punto! Porto il pane e il formaggio.
E io porto l'acqua e la mela!
Domani lavoriamo! Oggi è domenica: picnic!
Ciao Matteo! Il fine settimana è qui! Cosa fai?
Io gioco a calcio nel parco. E tu?
A me piace ballare! E mi piace la musica.
Balli? Io non ballo! Corro, nuoto, gioco a calcio...
E stasera? Guardiamo un film? Mi piacciono i film!
Sì, mi piacciono i film! Ma prima cucino: mi piace cucinare!
Ora! E poi nuotiamo: mi piace nuotare!
E il calcio?! Domenica giochiamo a calcio, sì?
Sì, sì! Domenica: calcio nel parco!
Perfetto! Musica ora, film stasera, calcio domenica!
